mapper.insert: INSERT INTO devine_moments (userId, title, content, location) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{location})
mapper.select: SELECT dm.momentId, dm.userId, dm.title, dm.content, dm.location, dm.likeCount, dm.commentCount, dm.createTime, dm.updateTime, u.nickName as userNickName, u.avatar as userAvatar, CASE WHEN dml.userId IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM devine_moments dm LEFT JOIN users u ON dm.userId = u.userId LEFT JOIN devine_moment_likes dml ON dm.momentId = dml.momentId AND dml.userId = #{currentUserId} ORDER BY dm.createTime DESC

SELECT dm.momentId, dm.userId, dm.title, dm.content, dm.location, dm.likeCount, dm.commentCount, dm.createTime, dm.updateTime, u.nickName as userNickName, u.avatar as userAvatar, CASE WHEN dml.userId IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM devine_moments dm LEFT JOIN users u ON dm.userId = u.userId LEFT JOIN devine_moment_likes dml ON dm.momentId = dml.momentId AND dml.userId = #{currentUserId} WHERE dm.momentId = #{momentId}

SELECT dm.momentId, dm.userId, dm.title, dm.content, dm.location, dm.likeCount, dm.commentCount, dm.createTime, dm.updateTime, u.nickName as userNickName, u.avatar as userAvatar, CASE WHEN dml.userId IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM devine_moments dm LEFT JOIN users u ON dm.userId = u.userId LEFT JOIN devine_moment_likes dml ON dm.momentId = dml.momentId AND dml.userId = #{currentUserId} WHERE dm.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY dm.createTime DESC
